verdict.rationale: Godot is fully open-source (MIT), users own all content/copyright with no royalties, and assets/projects live as plain files in the project folder rather than a locked proprietary cloud service (godot-docs-16, godot-docs-23, godot-docs-29, godot-docs-30, godot-docs-17). However, the evidence never explicitly documents that scene/resource files are open, portable text formats or shows a migration/export path away from Godot-specific structures. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of open/portable file formats (e.g., .tscn text format) and any guidance on exporting/migrating project data to other engines.
